scripts.dev: npm run dev:docker && concurrently --no-color -n backend,frontend "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.lint: npm --workspace frontend run lint && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm backend ./vendor/bin/pint --test
scripts.test: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm -e APP_ENV=testing -e DB_CONNECTION=sqlite -e DB_DATABASE=:memory: -e DB_HOST= -e DB_PORT= -e DB_URL= backend php artisan test
